name: Heroicons
summary: Tailwind Labs' icon set, made by the Tailwind team and a natural fit in Tailwind projects (the icons craft reference recommends it for Tailwind work).

steps: Import per size and weight path: 24/outline (default UI stroke), 24/solid (filled), 20/solid (compact UI), 16/solid (tiny UI).

files.role: Heroicon in a Tailwind button with size and color driven by classes

notes: Unlike lucide, Heroicons has no stroke-width prop: the weight comes from which outline or solid path you import. When a project already uses lucide, stay on lucide rather than mixing sets.
